settings.title: Settings
settings.about.appearance: Choose the app theme, the interface style and the code surface. Low-risk preferences are saved immediately.
settings.about.voice: Configure voice input and Live Voice in one place.
settings.about.agent: How much the agent may do without asking, and what it is allowed to reach.
settings.about.model: Which ternary pack runs on this machine, and where its weights live.
settings.about.reasoning: The sampler set the engine is launched with. The GGUF carries only temperature, top-k and top-p.
settings.section.code.desc: Choose code themes, font size, and display options independently from the interface font size.
settings.section.sampling.desc: These edit the {{mode}} profile; the other one keeps its own values.
settings.row.themeMode.desc: Choose light, dark, or follow the system theme.
settings.row.terminalTheme.desc: Follow the interface theme, or keep the appearance selected in the terminal.
settings.row.builtInBrowser: Use the built-in browser for terminal links
settings.row.builtInBrowser.desc: When off, HTTP and HTTPS links open in your system default browser.
settings.row.language.desc: The catalog every label in the app is read from.
settings.row.fontStyle.desc: The interface typeface. Code always stays monospaced.
settings.row.contentWidth.desc: Adjust the maximum width of task content and the composer.
settings.row.fileIcons.desc: Choose the file icon style used by task text and inline file references.
settings.row.glass.desc: Controls dialog mask blur, glass layers, and similar visual effects. Turn off to use solid backgrounds.
settings.row.lightCodeTheme.desc: Highlighting theme used for code content in the light interface.
settings.row.darkCodeTheme.desc: Highlighting theme used for code content in the dark interface.
settings.row.showLineNumbers.desc: Display line numbers in code and diff views.
settings.row.uiFontSize.desc: Adjust interface text without changing icons or layout dimensions.
settings.row.codeFontSize.desc: Adjust the default font size for code blocks, file previews, and diff views.
settings.row.inputDevice.desc: Choose the microphone for voice input, or follow the current system device automatically.
settings.row.voiceInput.desc: Use the microphone for voice input in the current task composer.
settings.row.recognitionPolish.desc: Clean up pauses, repetition, and punctuation so transcripts are ready to send.
settings.row.voiceprint.desc: Use voice characteristics from the start of each recording to reduce nearby speech.
settings.row.sendAutomatically.desc: With the DJI Mic Mini 2 collaboration kit, press once to start recording and again to stop and send.
settings.row.corrections.desc: Add proper names or terminology to improve recognition accuracy.
settings.row.liveVoiceShortcut.desc: Start Live Voice in the currently focused task composer, or end the active Live Voice task.
settings.row.approvalMode.desc: Reads and workspace edits run on their own; anything that leaves the machine asks first.
settings.row.shellTimeout.desc: A command still running after this long is stopped.
settings.row.compressAt.desc: Share of the model window after which older turns are summarized into a “Context compressed” divider.
settings.row.keepRecentTurns.desc: Recent turns, plus every open file, are kept verbatim.
settings.row.allowRemote.desc: Off: the app talks only to the engine on this machine, and the Local badge says so too.
settings.row.telemetry.desc: Nothing in this build collects or sends usage data, so there is nothing here to switch.
settings.row.packing.desc: Which quantization the engine loads. Auto probes Metal, CUDA, Vulkan or CPU and picks the best viable pack.
settings.row.modelDir.desc: Where the GGUF packs are stored on this machine.
settings.row.hfTokenEnv.desc: The name of an environment variable holding a read-only token for the gated repo. The token itself is never stored.
settings.row.offloadAllLayers.desc: Keep every layer resident on the accelerator. Off leaves the remainder on the CPU.
settings.row.flashAttention.desc: Fused attention kernels, where the selected backend supports them.
settings.row.visionLazyLoad.desc: Only pay for the vision tower when a message carries an image.
settings.row.dedicatedServerSlots.desc: Run the server with one slot and a bounded prompt cache, so the cache does not thrash across requests.
settings.row.effort.desc: Auto takes the effort the selected model publishes as its default. Low reasons about as long as Extra high: the chat template only accepts xhigh, medium and none.
settings.row.nonThinking.desc: Sample with the instruct profile. The model's measured quality comes from thinking mode.
settings.row.maxTokens.desc: A cap that is too small ends the run mid-thought and yields an empty reply.
settings.row.contextTokens.desc: Tokens the server reserves. The model's full window is 262144.
settings.row.temperature.desc: Model card: 1.0 in thinking mode, 0.7 in instruct.
settings.row.minP.desc: Floor relative to the best candidate. The GGUF carries no value for it, so the launcher always passes one.
settings.row.presencePenalty.desc: Also absent from the file, so it comes from here.
settings.row.repetitionPenalty.desc: Applied by the launcher rather than the GGUF header.
settings.row.systemPrompt.desc: The instruction every run starts from.
settings.voice.pending: Recording starts once the local engine is installed. These preferences are stored now.
